question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

ALIKE
solution: The correct answer is '**Different**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Alike**' is '**Different**'. • **Alike**: very similar. (बहुत समान, सर्वथा सदृश) • *Example: The two boys are very **alike**.* • **Different**: not the same. (भिन्‍न, अलग प्रकार का, एक जैसा नहीं) • *Example: The two houses are very **different** in style.* **Correct Answer:__** *Different.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Ordinary**: normal; not unusual or different from others. (साधारण; अन्‍यों से असामान्‍य या अलग नहीं, अन्‍यों के समान) • **Similar**: like somebody/something but not exactly the same. [किसी के समान (परंतु पूर्णतः वही नहीं); किसी के जैसा या सदृश] • **Same**: not different, not another or other; exactly the one or ones that you have mentioned before. (अलग नहीं, कोई और या अन्‍य नहीं; वही एकदम पहले वाला) 3e:T4b3, The correct answer is '**Illegible**'.
